task: Deepen (flagship 7): photo-editing, buildable item: Samsung SRW lens name (0xA003) and Sony maker-note lens names

doc_friction.issue: The item to replace sat in `buildable:`, not `next:`; the tool's 'not found in photo-editing.next' message did not say to try --field buildable, which cost one round trip.
photo-editing's next: is within ~50 characters of the 2000 cap, so landing one item means trimming history wording elsewhere in the same field.

goal: Name the lens for lensfun on Sony ARW and Samsung SRW files that carry no EXIF lens name, and break range ties on those that do.
notes: Real files: the 6 ARW and 4 SRW in drewnoakes/metadata-extractor-images (sparse clone through the proxy), lensfun master 52cf1a7. With the EXIF lens name dropped, 10/10 now pick the lens their own name gives (A500: ExifTool Minolta.pm names its LensType 55 'Sony DT 18-55mm F3.5-5.6 SAM (SAL1855) or SAM II'); before, 3 had no hint and 3 were refused as ties. Samsung list from metadata-extractor (Apache-2.0), credited in code; Sony LensSpec format implemented from its published description, no ExifTool code copied. Local checks: python3 platform/ci/run_venture_tests.py photo-editing -> ok (122.6s, 8 skipped), 1 suite, 0 failed; tests/test_sony_samsung_lens.py 12/12; check_post_frontmatter, check_post_links, post_similarity clean; portfolio/router/validate.py valid.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.
